harness run configuration (no AU ID): The run loader reads the sealed `harness_config` answer and applies the context policy, plan scaffold and action space to the next run. The loader receives the thresholds `soft_threshold` 0.6, `hard_threshold` 0.85 and `recent_window_fraction` 0.3 from the answer. It uses those values as fallback defaults only when the answer omits them. The loader decides nothing. It records the applied digest in the run trace. Proof: a run test that feeds a stored answer and asserts the applied parts. (receives EG-DECISION-ENGINE-R128)

harness sandbox quota and trace production (no AU ID): The harness asks served `Decide` with `runtime_quota` before each run and hands the four values to the sandbox. The values are received decisions. The harness holds no thresholds. At terminal commit the harness builds one `ReceiptNode` of kind `RunTrace` from its step log and attaches it to `CommitWorkItemResult`. It builds `RecursiveTraceNode` receipt nodes for recursive sub-calls. It reads `TraceCritique` pages to feed verifier and improvement critique. Proof: a run test with a stub engine asserting the sandbox limits and the attached receipts. (receives EG-DECISION-ENGINE-R133.3)

harness over-window split: The run loop asks served `Decide` with `context_budget` when a prompt may exceed its window. It splits the prompt as the plan says and merges the leaf answers. The depth, item, cost and model-call limits are received values. The loop decides nothing. Proof: a run test that feeds a stored plan with 4 chunks and asserts 7 model calls. (receives EG-DECISION-ENGINE-R137.3)

AU-CONTEXT-R004: The context compiler asks served `Decide` with `context_package` and applies the chosen ids and resolutions exactly. It never reranks or substitutes content. It keeps the source, range and revision citations. A changed source or budget needs a fresh decision. Proof: a compile test with a stored selection asserting the applied ids and citations. (receives EG-DECISION-ENGINE-R137.12)

AU:25 (AU-HARNESS-R026.3/.4): `run_full_rlm` measures the tool output bytes and the graph node count after each tool call. It builds the signal record and its digest. It asks served `Decide` with `recursion_mode` and runs direct or recursive execution as the result says. The thresholds are medulla values. Proof: a run test with a stub engine for each mode. (receives EG-DECISION-ENGINE-R137.13)

AU:37 (AU-HARNESS-R013.5/.10/.12/.13): The context manager runs the held-out queries on the raw and candidate contexts. It builds the paired verdict set. It asks served `Decide` with `context_replacement`. It replaces the active context only when the sealed result is `replace`. Otherwise it keeps the raw revision. Proof: a run test for the replace and retain cases. (receives EG-DECISION-ENGINE-R137.14)

AU:40 (AU-HARNESS-R026.1/.4, R024.1/.3): `RLMEnvironment.run_parallel_sub_calls` asks served `Decide` with `sub_call_admission` before each call. After the call it validates the output against the signature output schema. It records success only on a match. It binds the signature, model and tool digests in the span. Proof: a run test for a matching and a mismatching output. (receives EG-DECISION-ENGINE-R137.15)

AU:59 (AU-HARNESS-R024.2/.6): The run loop asks served `Decide` with `instruction_disclosure` once before the first action (phase `initial`). It asks again whenever a trigger occurs (phase `runtime`). It applies the exact selected versions. It records each event with phase, trigger, version, digest, run, sequence and the applied or refused outcome. Proof: a run test asserting initial instructions precede the first action. (receives EG-DECISION-ENGINE-R137.100)
